question: How does the elaboration of the five powers relate to the supreme triad?
premises: In that same context there is an elaboration involving the five powers and so on.
In the middle that triad appears divided.
Even so, that triad is indeed supreme.
inference: The elaboration into five powers occurs within the triad, yet the triad remains the supreme reality.
plain_english: There indeed, by elaboration, there is the application of the five powers and so on; thus, though divided in the middle, that triad is indeed supreme.
